scientific_limitations: The full equilibrium cut-size histogram and optimum counts are established by the November 8 weighted-wheel phase-diagram theorem, and the Perrin enumeration is classical. Originality is confined to the explicit central limit law, cumulant slopes, and exponentially small optimum fraction under uniform stable-state sampling. Only unweighted synchronous minority fixed points are studied.
title: Gaussian cut-quality fluctuations among locally stable configurations on wheels
